sections.text:
It is a protection unit designed for use in three phase networks with the 
neutral earthed directly or through an impedance

The 
operating principle involved consists of detecting over-current contingent on 
phase to phase faults or earth faults
Each protection unit consists of an enclosure housing the following component

Three 
RMA 421 current measuring relay for detecting phase to phase fault

RT 210 
definite time - lage relay

sections.text:
Over 
current measuring relays are designed on the principle of an electromagnetic 
balance the balance arm is maintained in equilibrium by two opposing forces

The 
first of these forces is the electromagnetic attraction between two high-pemeability 
magnetic cores in the field of an induction coil through which the current be 
monitored passes.

The 
opposing force is produced by a restoring spring

Definite 
time lag relay consist of a rotary electromagnet acting on an adjustable time 
delay device which produces rapid contact movement at the end of the relay 
period

sections.text: Work to be carried out
Testing the Relay, and Protection Output

items: Carefully follow all test procedure steps from 2 to 7

Verify the test result match the relay setting. If not consult technical 
 services
Test trip the circuit breaker associated with the relay

sections.text: Preparation

items:
Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted at the incoming terminal blocks before 
 isolating the relay current circuits for test

Look at field maintenance file and compare the position of the setting 
 switches on relay with those shown on the setting sheet

sections.text: Current Test

items: Label the wires before removing its from terminal block of the relay
Remove the input current terminals number 1,2,3,4,5 and 6 from the relay

Connect test leads between the current terminals number 1 and 2 on the 
 relay to the current terminals on the test set

Slowly increase the current until the red indication on over-current 
 element of phase R on the relay appears The relay must operate with a 
 current between 5% of the setting value
Record this value on the test sheet
Increase the injected current with a value 25% greater than the operating value
Slowly decrease the current until the relay resets
Record this value on the test sheet

sections.text: Time Test

items: Inject current higher than the setting value so the relay picks up firmly
Keep the injected current and switch off the test set

Connect the time delayed contacts number 14 and 26 on the relay to timer 
 terminals on the test set
Switch on the test set

Start the test by injecting current into the relay. The timer will stop 
 once the relay has picked up
Record this value of time on the test sheet

Repeat the above test from step 1 to step 6 for other phase, but inject 
 current at terminal 3 and 4 for phase S and terminals 5 and 6 for phase T

sections.text: Trip Test

items: Request the operator to switch on the main circuit breaker
Operate the output - delayed - contact by hand to trip the circuit breaker
Check that the circuit breaker trip
